text_block_list.text:
Among the roster for the Japan Cup are
Zenno
Rob Roy and Спешл Уик, both
of who have
returned to racing after a
long hiatus.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Both are top-tier racers—but that is
within
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The crowd awaits with bated breath,
anticipating
a fierce battle ahead.
Meanwhile, Эйсин Флэш
maintains a
confident resolve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
